title: Houkago Ren'ai Club: Koi no Etude
native_title: 放課後恋愛クラブ ～恋のエチュード～
overview:
Love doesn't need a reason, so why not try falling in love casually and wonderfully!?

You want to take love seriously, but love is something that sprouts suddenly, for no reason. That's exactly why it would be nice if people could go out with each other in a more relaxed way, and why meeting someone should be thought of as something easier. That idea is what started the "After School Love Club." This game depicts romances with various girls, centered on the family restaurant "Starry Sky" that serves as the club's meeting room.

根拠がないのが恋だから気軽に、ステキに、恋愛してみない!?

恋愛はまじめに取り組みたいけど、恋なんて理由もなく突然芽生えるもの。
だからこそもっとお互い気軽な気持ちで付き合えたらいいと思うし、出会いはもっと手軽なものとして考えたい。そんな思いから発足したのが"放課後恋愛クラブ"。
このゲームでは、クラブの部室になっているファミレス「Starry Sky」を舞台の中心に、色々な女の子との恋愛模様を描いています。
